title: Folding main does not reconcile a tick the operator closed while the run had it claimed
body: ha9 was closed on main at fa9479e7, and the run's fold (25729a3e) brought main into the epic branch — yet the merge resolved .tick/issues/ha9.json to the run's own claim-side version (in_progress, touched by the run's claim and note commits 00f05b7e/18be362c one minute before the merge), silently dropping the operator's close. qu3, which the run had not touched, folded through as closed cleanly. The orchestrator therefore still sees ha9 open and dispatched attempts 12–14 to rediscover nothing; attempt 11's proposed remedy (fold the default branch before dispatch) is proven insufficient for claimed ticks. A fix is either a merge-time reconciliation of tracker records under claim (closed-on-main wins, or at least surfaces) or a dispatch check that reads the default branch's record for ticks whose only open state is the run's own claim.
